stem.text: Oxidation of ethanedioate ions by acidified manganate(VII) ions is very slow at room temperature.
Which graph shows how the concentration of acidified manganate(VII) ions varies after ethanedioate ions are added?

A.alt: Graph of concentration of MnO4- against time: starts at zero, rises slowly, then steeply, then levels off (S-shaped rise)

B.alt: Graph of concentration of MnO4- against time: starts high, falls slowly, then steeply, then levels off at zero (S-shaped fall)

C.alt: Graph of concentration of MnO4- against time: starts high and falls steeply, then levels off close to zero (exponential decay)

D.alt: Graph of concentration of MnO4- against time: starts at zero, rises steeply, then levels off at a constant value
